ana (PM): Heads-up: I sketched a ~2-sprint observability mini-roadmap for Console. Keep scope tiny: 1) per-route cost heatmap + export, 2) lightweight trace links from latency spikes, 3) error histogram + grouped alerting. Aim: pilot with 2 customers. Thoughts?
devin (eng): Compact scope is good. Tech asks: we need route tagging from edge (~1 day), a small materialized view for cost queries (~3 days), and an export endpoint (~1 day). Backfill optional.
ruth (sre): Sampling must be cheap. Propose dynamic sampling: base 0.25% for high QPS routes, bump to 100% on error. Also want trace_id surfaced to UI via response header when enabled.
yara (design): I can do 3 compact card layouts: heatmap (rows=routes, cols=time), latency with direct "open trace" button, error histogram with top signatures. Will keep mobile-friendly.
tom (cs): Customers D and E specifically asked for per-route and per-deployment CSVs with timezone-aware timestamps + cost estimate column. Also requested admin toggle for exports.
nana (PM): (typo) I mean ana above :)
nana (PM): Proposed launch criteria: templates in Console, pilot customer using export + trace link, ops runbook for sampling, and docs. Ship goal: end of sprint 4.
devin (eng): Risk: tagging rollout needs feature flag to avoid corrupting metrics. Backfill is heavy; recommend GA without, document gap. Also need a simple route->model mapping service (+1 dev-day).
ruth (sre): Alerting suggestion: group by error fingerprint, rate-limit notifications, include top trace link and sample requests in alert payload. Example threshold: warn if error_rate >0.01 over 24h, alert if >0.03.
yara (design): UI copy: 'Capture full traces on errors' and 'Default sampling rate'. I'll add a small explainer modal about cost-estimate assumptions.
tom (cs): For pilots, please include a privacy opt-out for PII-sensitive routes. We'll surface that to pilot customers when recruiting.
ci-bot: CI passed: feature/obs-mini-roadmap-build #987 :white_check_mark:
devin (eng): Action items: spike on tagging+mapping (due 2026-04-03), add export endpoint (due 2026-04-05).
nana (PM): Action items recap: @devin spike+export, @yara mocks by 2026-03-29, @ruth ops doc by 2026-03-30, @tom recruit pilots this week.
tom (cs): Starting outreach now.
devin (eng): Ack.
